what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee elected Tom Alonso chair by roll call, with Alonso abstaining, after a competing nomination for chair was withdrawn.
Dave Passios was elected vice chair by roll call.
Peter was elected clerk by roll call.
The committee set its next meeting for October 17 at 5:30, scheduling one month at a time, with the larger departments (schools, DPW, facilities) to present first.
The first item at the next meeting will be a review of Heather's letter on adjustments to the process and a discussion of the ranking and scoring system.

why_it_matters: The Capital Planning Committee ranks the town's capital projects, so its new leadership and its review of the scoring system shape which requests move forward to residents' votes.
Having the schools, DPW and facilities present first means the largest capital requests get the most time for questions.
